decisions.reason: After two years this safety-shoe line remains in the firm’s core category, and without clear negative signals the value of keeping the option open still exceeds the cost of carrying it.
The supportive insole is relatively cheap to maintain and, with one weaker insole already removed, it is still worth keeping while the firm tests whether it holds a distinct place in the range.
The ergonomic safety-shoe series appears strategically important to the firm’s innovation positioning, so management would be unlikely to withdraw it unless results had turned clearly disappointing.
These firefighter and rescue boots serve a narrower niche, but they fit the firm’s protective-footwear capabilities and likely merit more time given specialized demand and longer adoption cycles.
As a flagship insole direction highlighted by the firm, it would be kept on the market because it still carries high strategic learning value and strong signaling importance.
